name: Juggle the Ball

meta.name: Juggle the Ball
meta.tagline: Keep the ball bouncing by getting the paddle underneath it.
meta.description: Move a paddle to bounce a falling ball back into the air. Each bounce can send the ball sideways depending on where it lands, so track its motion and keep repositioning the paddle. The episode ends when the ball is missed or the time limit is reached.

rewardTerms.description: Accumulated ball height above the paddle, scaled by the episode limit.
Ball missed and the episode ended.
Fraction of steps spent moving the paddle.

presets.name: default
presets.description: Build height while keeping the ball in play.

presets.name: aggressive
presets.description: Prioritize scoring as many bounces as possible.

presets.name: survivalist
presets.description: Favor safe, high bounces and avoid risky movement.

human.hint: Use the left and right arrow keys to move the paddle.
